verdict.rationale: FreeAgent's quick start documents a separate sandbox API (api.sandbox.freeagent.com) that is distinct from the production API (api.freeagent.com). Developers can obtain tokens and test their app against it, keeping production data untouched. This is true environment isolation, not a dry-run mode, but the evidence is a thin quick-start mention. Missing for 10: documentation of sandbox account provisioning, data seeding/reset and parity with production, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: To use the production API (instead of the sandbox one) change the two endpoints to reference **api.freeagent.com** instead of api.sandbox.freeagent.com
use it to test out your own app with the FreeAgent API before you implement OAuth authentication
